name: Masquerade ~Kamen Yuugi~
source:
Main character has the power to manipulate personalities in the direction desired by clients. Among other cases one day he gets a request to get rid of multiple personalities in young man's lover. So starts his adventure to the labyrinth of girl's heart.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公拥有一种能力，可以按照委托人的要求操纵他人的人格。某天，在处理过各式各样的案件后，他接到一项委托：消除一名年轻男子恋人体内的多重人格。主人公就此踏入少女心灵的迷宫，展开新的冒险。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-february-2002-kusarihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
